class IncludeTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.d = self._tmp.name
        self.addCleanup(self._tmp.cleanup)

    def write(self, name, text):
        path = os.path.join(self.d, name)
        os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            fh.write(text)
        return path

    def test_basic_and_override_order(self):
        self.write("inc.conf", "a = 1\\nb = 1\\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "a = 0\\n@include inc.conf\\nb = 2\\n")

        self.write("sub/leaf.conf", "x = 5\\n")
        self.write("sub/mid.conf", "@include leaf.conf\\n")
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include sub/mid.conf\\n")
        self.assertEqual(load(main).get("x"), 5)

    def test_missing(self):
        main = self.write("main.conf", "@include nope.conf\\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(main)

    def test_cycles(self):
        self.write("a.conf", "@include b.conf\\n")
        self.write("b.conf", "@include a.conf\\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(os.path.join(self.d, "a.conf"))
        self_inc = self.write("s.conf", "@include s.conf\\n")
        with self.assertRaises(ConfigError):
            load(self_inc)

    def test_repeated_non_cyclic_include(self):
        self.write("c.conf", "k = 1\\n")
        main = self.write("m.conf", "@include c.conf\\n@include c.conf\\n")
        self.assertEqual(load(main).get("k"), 1)
